text:
tia_engineer: Customer 'beta-search' reports intermittent 413s + tail latency on /embeddings for mixed-dim batches (mostly 128 + a few 2048s). Payload ~3MB, ~100 items. Any ideas?

olivia_support: They pasted an example. About 20% of calls get 413, rest are slow. They tried splitting by count and it helped.

nate_sre: Two suspects: ingress preflight estimator fast-failing on estimated units; router splitter chunks by bytes not dim; GPU runtime pads to kernel-friendly widths so a few big dims blow up memory.

maya_prod: We tightened per-route byte budgets to avoid OOMs, which explains new rejects. The byte-based splitter is cheap but blind to dim variance.

tia_engineer: Proposal: add a cheap sampler (inspect first N items to build dim histogram) and if variance exceeds threshold, prefer split-by-dim. Sampling adds a micro latency but avoids repeated 413s.

olivia_support: From support POV, also need better error text. 413 is confusing when the HTTP body isn't actually too big. Suggest we include cause="estimate" and suggested_action keys in the response.

devex-bot: DEVEX-320 exists for x-embed-units docs; can extend with split helpers.

nate_sre: Telemetry: add tags embed_split_mode={byte,dim,client} and metrics max_dim/median_dim per request so we can correlate 413 rate with dim skew.

maya_prod: UX idea: Console route diagnostics could offer a "Recommend split plan" button that runs the sampler on a pasted payload and returns a client-side split suggestion (group by dim buckets). Low lift and helps customers.

tia_engineer: Implementation plan: (1) telemetry + sampler (1 sprint), (2) SDK split helpers + console recommend (2 sprints), (3) server-side opt-in dim-aware splitter behind flag (3+ sprints). I'll open PLAT tickets.

olivia_support: Immediate workaround communicated: split by dim groups or reduce max vectors per request; customer confirmed improvement.

nate_sre: Also agree we should avoid flipping to 429 immediately. Instead include structured reason in body: {"cause":"estimate","reason":"dim-skew","suggested_action":"split-by-dim"} and keep 413 for now. Then decide later after telemetry.

maya_prod: I'll prototype console mock for recommended_action values ["split-by-dim","set-x-embed-units","request-dedicated"].

tia_engineer: Tickets: PLAT-772 (sampler + telemetry), PLAT-773 (SDK helpers + console recommend), MON-909 (dashboards & alerts).

olivia_support: I'll add KB article with sample split script and link once SDK helpers land.

tia_engineer: Thanks all — leaving thread open for follow-ups.
